capabilities: Browse daily notes in week and month calendar grids
Render Markdown previews inside day cells
Filter displayed sections by heading rules
Open notes via click or hover/long-press popup preview
extras: Ships a dual release line: odd patch versions target Obsidian 1.7.2-1.12.x, even patch versions target 1.13.0+; installation is manual only (copy files into the plugins folder); UI supports Japanese and English.
intentEvidence: Daily note folder and date format follow the core Daily notes plugin settings.
problem: The core Daily notes feature lists notes as files, giving no at-a-glance calendar overview of what each day's note contains.
summary: Calendar plugin that shows Daily Notes in week and month views with inline Markdown previews rendered inside each day cell.
